rust_summary: a client resource-pack reload completion notification (`native_client_resources_reloaded`).
doc_summary: `native_client_resources_reloaded()` fires on the render thread after successful client resource-pack application: the atlas, models, renderer and client caches already use the new resources. It covers selection/F3+T and server-pack reloads. Failed staging or application and initial startup do not fire it. This is a completion notification, not a reload-listener registration or staging API. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_resources_reloaded@.
